text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're visiting the shrine today.

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
Please, dear Umamusume... I leave<n>the shrine in
your hands.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, you've gotta get it together!<n>Come on! Stay with
us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chief priest falls ill and entrusts<n>the shrine to
Tamamo Cross for a<n>short time while he recovers.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Never thought I'd be filling in for the<n>priest, but if the
shrine needs me, I'll<n>step up to the plate!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I hope he recovers quick. In the<n>meantime, I'll be
here to talk to the<n>visitors.

text_block_list.name: Female Students
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! The priest's an<n>Umamusume! She's
so cute!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey! No screaming! Aren't<n>ya here to
pray?

text_block_list.name: Female Students
text_block_list.text:
And she serves a real sharp quip!<n>She's even
more cute once you hear<n>her speak!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What? I don't get it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wisecracking Umamusume priest<n>becomes the
talk of the town,<n>attracting more visitors to the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guess I should wish for something<n>while I'm here.
Okay...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wish for everything to turn out okay.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What kind of a wish is that? Just<n>"okay"?!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is weird. I'm glad the shrine is<n>bustling with
visitors, but why are<n>they all watchin' me? Do they
think<n>I'm funny 'cause I'm from Naniwa?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh. In that case, I guess I'll just keep<n>being myself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've got a comeback for everyone!<n>The funnier they
are, the better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who will visit and what<n>kind of reaction
they'll get.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hey Yaeno, Ardan, come over here!<n>Let's pray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Good friends Sakura Chiyono O,<n>Yaeno Muteki, and
Mejiro Ardan<n>arrive at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Dear God... Please hear my prayer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry, I feel lightheaded. The<n>stone stairway up
here was pretty<n>steep.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then catch your breath before ya<n>start talkin'!
You're leavin' the gods<n>hangin' here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This silence... It's perfect for<n>practicing the ancient
martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No! You're supposed to pray!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's right, Yaeno. It's important to<n>visit the shrine
properly. I have a<n>proverb for that in my notebook.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Those who believe are saved."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What are you talkin' about? That<n>doesn't even
have anythin' to do<n>with what we said!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Seriously, what is up with those<n>guys?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
At least they gave me some good<n>material to work
with! The visitors<n>loved it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her three quirky visitors,<n>the humorous
priest gains even more<n>popularity.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Silent, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aw, come on! Ya gotta saysomethin'!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You got it! ☆ Something!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Rubae! Miracle! Wahey! ☆<n>Boo-boo-boom!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I didn't literally mean "something"!<n>Don't be so
pleased with yaself!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's visitors were either silent or<n>completely
nonsensical, but Tamamo<n>Cross still managed to
get some<n>laughs out of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt runners Hokko Tarumae, Copano<n>Rickey, and
Wonder Acute arrive at<n>the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if my prayers will really<n>do anything,
but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I pray that I will be able to make my<n>hometown of
Tomakomai proud.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'd feel kinda bad making fun of<n>that wish.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the red color from the torii<n>gate is in this
position so...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're well protected from<n>natural
disasters here, Priest. Great<n>landform! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Um, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Agh, what am I even supposed to say<n>to that? I
guess these dirt runners<n>just have a different kind
of vibe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: There, there. Would you like a<n>sweetie?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross fails to make her<n>usual witty
comebacks and ends up<n>being consoled instead.
Her<n>enthusiasm dwindles.
